content:
200
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Portal successfully retrieved the details for the specified account group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string <uuid>
The UUID of the account group.
string <uuid>
The UUID of the account group's parent container.
string
The name of the account group.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the account
group was last modified. For example, 1710256733 .
integer
The number of accounts contained in the account group.
account_group_uuid
required
accountGroupUuid
parentContainerUuid
name
lastModified
count
Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
An array of account UUIDs that belong to the account group.
— 403
Returned if you do not have permissions to retrieve the details for the specified account group. For
more information, see Permissions.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified account group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
